name: grasps
status: placeholder until the reference papers are in hand
description: Set A: static grasp-type poses, camera only, bare left hand, final configuration only. This list is the working placeholder from the plan (the classic six plus common additions from the Feix GRASP taxonomy). When the professor's reference papers are in hand, every label becomes the paper's own term, source and figure are filled in, and a grasp named differently in two papers keeps both names.

items.label: cylindrical grasp
items.shape: all fingers wrap a vertical cylinder, thumb closes over them from the other side

items.label: spherical grasp
items.shape: fingers spread and curved around a ball, thumb opposes, palm cupped

items.label: hook grasp
items.shape: four fingers bent at the middle and end joints into a hook, thumb relaxed and not used

items.label: lateral (key) pinch
items.shape: thumb pad presses on the side of the bent index finger, other fingers curled

items.label: tip pinch (thumb to index)
items.shape: thumb tip meets index tip, both curved into a round O, other fingers relaxed

items.label: tripod (three-jaw chuck)
items.shape: thumb pad meets the index and middle pads together, ring and little curled

items.label: palmar pinch (thumb pad to index pad)
items.shape: thumb pad meets index pad with both fingers flatter than a tip pinch, others relaxed

items.label: extension (plate) grasp
items.shape: fingers straight and together, thumb straight and apart, as if a flat plate sits between them

items.label: lateral tripod
items.shape: thumb presses the object against the side of the middle finger, index resting on top

items.label: power sphere
items.shape: whole hand wraps a large ball with the palm in contact, fingers spread

items.label: precision disc
items.shape: fingertips spread around the rim of a disc such as a jar lid, palm off the object

items.label: writing tripod
items.shape: pen held between the thumb pad and index pad, resting on the side of the middle finger
